name: Simone Chiaretta
quote: I had the pleasure of working with Warren during our migration of an Umbraco site from v13 to v16. He played a fundamental role in the success of the project, not only by driving the migration itself but also by bringing our team up to speed with the new UI technology introduced in v16.

Warren’s expertise, professionalism, and ability to share knowledge made him an invaluable partner. He quickly became a trusted point of reference for both technical challenges and best practices. Thanks to his contribution, our team was able to adopt the new technology with confidence and deliver the project smoothly.
I wholeheartedly recommend Warren to any organization looking for a skilled, collaborative, and impactful professional.
